response.sql: WITH media_type_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM media_type_rates) SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.track_count, r.rate - o.mean_rate AS rate_above_mean FROM media_type_rates AS r CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o WHERE r.rate > o.mean_rate
